reader_contract: The query-conditioned reader sees only the official input and question. It never receives the answer or HotpotQA support labels. Each document sketch is computed independently as title plus the highest query/title-overlap sentence, preserving exact append-only prefixes.
dual_path_contract: The identical charged state feeds (1) a compact evidence prompt and (2) Qwen2 latent replay at relative depth 0.875. A sample-clustered calibration simplex always includes the exact Foundation corner and is enabled only when its 95% paired lower confidence bound is positive.

state_budget_rule.origin: The 38/69/92 Qwen2.5 replay-token law and relative depth 0.875 were registered and executed on official RULER multiquery before the HotpotQA dual-path seed existed; they are reused without HotpotQA strength or depth search.
state_budget_rule.charged_bytes: replay_tokens * (2 * hidden_size bfloat16 bytes + 8 int64 token-id bytes)
state_budget_rule.relative_cost_gate: Both co-scaled and fixed-small-state bytes per model parameter must strictly decrease at both adjacent transitions.

primary_estimand: paired per-example Foundation minus effective dual-path ASCENT answer NLL on the 40 untouched test rows
factorial_estimand: For each adjacent Foundation and memory transition, [(large Foundation gain from memory expansion) - (small Foundation gain from the same memory expansion)] with a paired 95% LCB above zero.

controls.fixed: graph_small state evaluated on every Foundation
controls.memory_only_scaling: graph_small, graph_mid, and graph_large each evaluated on every Foundation, forming a complete 3x3 factorial panel
controls.query_only: co-scale-matched BM25 sketches without title-graph expansion
controls.irrelevant: co-scale-matched bottom-ranked sketches outside the seed/title frontier whenever possible
controls.path_ablations: certified-only and latent-only NLL are saved before safe fusion

development_success_rule.co_scaled_gain: All three co-scaled safe gates open and all paired NLL-gain 95% LCBs are positive.
development_success_rule.scale_complementarity: Both adjacent co-scaled gain-difference LCBs and the per-example log-parameter slope LCB are positive.
development_success_rule.foundation_state_interaction: Both adjacent 2x2 factorial interaction LCBs and the global small-large interaction LCB are positive.
development_success_rule.fixed_control: Co-scaled ASCENT beats graph_small Fixed at 1.5B and 3B with positive LCBs.
development_success_rule.retrieval_controls: Graph beats query-only BM25 at 3B and beats irrelevant state at every endpoint with positive LCBs.
development_success_rule.dual_path: At least one co-scaled gate selects nonzero certified weight and at least one selects nonzero latent weight.
development_success_rule.systems: Task/config/model/commit/clean-tree/native-context/no-label-reader/shared-state/exact-prefix/cross-foundation-token-identity and both relative-state gates all pass.

promotion_rule: Only development_pass=true from the frozen analyzer authorizes official autoregressive decoding on this seed and three entirely new official HotpotQA confirmation seeds. No partial gate pass authorizes tuning on seed 386803.
failure_rule: Any missed gate is retained as a development failure. The next design, if any, must be independently motivated and use untouched data; the observed seed cannot be tuned into confirmation.
ceiling_policy: Continuous answer NLL is primary and has no 100% accuracy ceiling. Any later official accuracy is reported with absolute gain and prospectively frozen remaining-error elimination; perfect ASCENT means 100% of remaining Foundation error removed, never a requirement above 1.0.
